_comment: Machine-level paths + runtime for BOOKSMITH tools. SEPARATE from per-book book_config.json. This is the portability seam: moving the kit to another machine means editing ONLY this file. Values below are this machine's known-good setup (Windows 11, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB, Word installed).

word.note: docx->PDF via win32com Dispatch('Word.Application'), SaveAs FileFormat=17. Requires installed Microsoft Word. No cross-platform fallback wired.

node.note: REQUIRED (interior DOCX generators). Any Node >= 14. Dependencies ship vendored in _tools/node_modules; if that folder is absent run: npm install --prefix _tools

python.note: Canonical audited list: requirements.txt at the repo root. pywin32 = Windows-only (Word COM, Tier-1 print). requests / tiktoken / jsonschema are optional (KEEL vision / token counts / GATE-2 config validation).

cover_gen.note: checkpoints_dir is EMPTY by default; run the setup step to fetch sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors (~6.5GB) via fetcher or `comfy model download` before first cover gen. Flux-dev-fp8 (~12GB) opt-in when VRAM is free.

vision.api: POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-format; image as base64 data URI in an image_url content part); read choices[0].message.content
vision.fallback: claude — the harness's own vision via imguard-resized image read from disk

model.note: The deterministic engine (engine.py) calls the model as a PURE FUNCTION (model_client.py) for prose generation. backend: anthropic (Claude via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var; best prose) | openai (any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions at openai_base_url, e.g. a local llama-server; sovereign/offline) | mock (deterministic, network-free; used by engine --dry-run). The model is NEVER given tools.
